provenance.origin: Evidence Lab curation of cross-disciplinary research procedures from a pinned K-Dense Scientific Agent Skills revision and an existing bilingual writing workflow.
evidence: Evidence Lab skill catalog review dated 2026-08-25

skills.name: citation-management
skills.summary: Finds, verifies, deduplicates, and formats scholarly citation metadata and BibTeX.

skills.name: database-lookup
skills.summary: Retrieves facts reproducibly from documented public database APIs with explicit filters and provenance.

skills.name: experimental-design
skills.summary: Produces an interpretable study design, randomization or blocking plan, and reproducible layout.

skills.name: exploratory-data-analysis
skills.summary: Profiles supported local research data and reports quality, missingness, leakage, and sensitivity diagnostics.

skills.name: hypothesis-generation
skills.summary: Turns observations into testable hypotheses, rivals, predictions, measurements, and preregistration artefacts.

skills.name: literature-review
skills.summary: Produces a documented review protocol, screening trail, evidence table, synthesis, and verified bibliography.

skills.name: markdown-mermaid-writing
skills.summary: Creates versionable structural diagrams and consistent Markdown layouts using Mermaid and focused style rules.

skills.name: markitdown
skills.summary: Converts supported local documents and selected sources to normalized Markdown for analysis and indexing.

skills.name: paper-lookup
skills.summary: Searches scholarly APIs and returns deduplicated paper records, identifiers, provenance, and available full text.

skills.name: peer-review
skills.summary: Builds an evidence-bounded manuscript assessment with claim, method, statistics, ethics, and reproducibility checks.

skills.name: scientific-critical-thinking
skills.summary: Audits claims, assumptions, causal language, bias, confounding, and evidence quality.

skills.name: scientific-visualization
skills.summary: Designs and audits truthful, accessible, publication-oriented scientific figures and export settings.

skills.name: statistical-analysis
skills.summary: Produces a confirmed analysis plan, diagnostics, effect sizes, uncertainty, and bounded statistical reporting.

skills.name: statistical-power
skills.summary: Calculates power, sample size, sensitivity, or minimum detectable effects from explicit assumptions.

skills.name: uncertainty-and-units
skills.summary: Checks units, performs conversions, propagates uncertainty, and formats results with an audit trail.

skills.name: writing-skill
skills.summary: Routes evidence-bounded Russian or English writing by genre, including an academic and scientific mode.
